scope: Obstacle-enabled development starts, first episodes only. One warmup trace submission precedes reset; post-reset submissions are 2 through reported episode length plus one, inclusive. Listed trace steps retain submission numbering. Scene contacts are not necessarily the fatal collider, and no minimum obstacle clearance is computed. Full-substep observed velocities compared with engineering velocity limits from the matching research model; final substep velocity at a limit indicates clamping but not its cause. Endpoint q/attitude and recorded collision impulses do not establish continuous clearance. No biological, perturbed-flight, mission or landing qualification.
